snippet.title: EVERYBODY'S GOLF HOT SHOTS – Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A golf game for everyone is smashing its way across the fairway! Tee up with friends, solo challenging tournaments, or take a swing at other zany modes when EVERYBODY'S GOLF HOT SHOTS arrives later this year! Let's par-TEE!
